scheme_name: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Grant to Industrial Cooperative Society
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to any group of artisans
Applicant must be enlisted in the State Portal for artisans & weavers
Industrial cooperative society must possess a piece of land for work shed or machine installation
Applicant must be an Indian citizen permanent resident of West Bengal for the past 10 years
Cooperative society must consist of at least 10 artisans
benefits_summary: Grant up to ₹3,00,000 for tools/equipment and up to ₹7,00,000 for work shed and other fixed assets.
